fieldData.full-article-text: Following successful completion of the Olympia Betanet, the Olympia Mainnet will launch. This is the first live version of the Radix Public network and will be fully permissionless and decentralized. The Radix Foundation will never at any time have any ability to apply permissions to mainnet validators.
fieldData.author: 69eb1e37d22c65f903fdf05d
fieldData.name: What is the Olympia Mainnet?
